result.summary: The page is mostly intact, but the horizontal restaurant list has a clear truncation problem where the last card and its restaurant name are clipped at the right edge.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' list is cut off on the right side, and its name is displayed as 'Trattoria Piccol' (missing final characters).
issues.suggestion: Increase the horizontal scroll padding, adjust card widths, or truncate with an ellipsis and ensure the full name is readable on the card or after scrolling into full view.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccol' restaurant name appears truncated because the card width is too narrow.
issues.suggestion: Allow the card to fully render the restaurant name, or use a smaller font size / multi-line text for longer names in fixed-width cards.
